mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We currently have clear skies and 54 degrees outside near Verona City Hall under a New Moon. Look out for the International Space Station passing overhead tonight at 6:30 PM for two minutes, rising in the south southwest over Belleville toward Fitchburg and reaching about halfway up the sky. Overnight, temperatures will dip to 43 degrees with rain expected.

In city news, the Mark Drive reconstruction project is making progress on phase two between North Nine Mound Road and Westlawn Avenue. Crews are currently wrapping up concrete curb, sidewalk, and driveway installation while preparing the roadway for the base layer of asphalt, with final surface paving scheduled for next spring.

Looking at local events, trivia lovers have plenty of options today with trivia hosted at Hop Haus Brewing Co., Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow features Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, along with additional trivia nights at The Mill and The Bogey Factory.

In weekly police news, on Thursday, October 23rd, officers contacted two 13-year-old juveniles riding prohibited eMotos on Ashton Drive after previous warnings, resulting in citations for both parents for permitting a minor to drive a motor vehicle.
Finally, Culver's of Verona is open until 10:00 PM today featuring Chocolate Heath Crunch as today's flavor of the day, with Chocolate Caramel Twist scheduled for tomorrow.
